core_categories: Pharmaceuticals; Clinical Trial Materials; Medical Equipment; Medical Consumables; Specialty Medicines; Third-Party Logistics
specialty_focus: Durbin PLC is a global specialist medical supplier and distributor, part of the Uniphar Group. It sources and supplies pharmaceuticals, clinical trial materials, medical equipment, and consumables to healthcare professionals, NGOs, and humanitarian projects in over 160 countries. It also provides managed access programs and third-party logistics with temperature-controlled storage.
